5d932b48fe3e0af5.en: Which issue cannot yet be treated as resolved?
5d932b48fe3e0af5.zh: 哪个问题还不能视为已经解决？

02d7b9f65ab519b6.en: Deleting a page does not always end access to its file. New information must be passed on confidentially, without public redistribution.
02d7b9f65ab519b6.zh: 删除页面并不总能阻止访问文件。新信息应在保密条件下转交，不得公开再传播。

3b8be8d354b94a05.en: Access to the file has not been checked. Full remediation of the violation is not yet confirmed.
3b8be8d354b94a05.zh: 尚未核查文件可访问性，无法确认违法问题已彻底消除。

2a9eb76b150f3b3b.en: Several days have passed in the simulation. The school says the publication has been removed. Maria Viktorovna adds that the file link in search results still opens.
2a9eb76b150f3b3b.zh: 模拟中已过数日。学校称已删除公开内容。玛丽亚·维克托罗芙娜补充说，搜索结果中的文件链接仍可打开。

7ae5f0fd5b286022.en: Close the case: the school’s statement is enough.
7ae5f0fd5b286022.zh: 结案：学校的说明已经足够。

dadb244a8eb1f459.en: Send the file to all parents for checking.
dadb244a8eb1f459.zh: 将文件发给所有家长核查。

e3831fb044580071.en: Record the newly accessible address without spreading its contents, forward the clarification to the authorised recipient and keep monitoring.
e3831fb044580071.zh: 记录新发现的可访问地址，不传播内容；向授权收件人转交补充信息，并继续跟踪。

334516cc6d4bae62.en: The clarification has been added to the file. The next steps have been explained to the applicant; no final outcome is announced before confirmation.
334516cc6d4bae62.zh: 补充信息已归入案卷，已向申请人说明后续程序；未经确认不宣布最终结果。

ed303810732a6328.en: Health information is always publicly available.
ed303810732a6328.zh: 健康信息始终属于公开信息。

0ec8a96cadcbaba8.en: Publication online cancels the processing requirements.
0ec8a96cadcbaba8.zh: 信息一经上网公开，处理要求就不再适用。

418460193e1bee95.en: Find the article classifying health information as a special category of personal data.
418460193e1bee95.zh: 查找将健康状况信息列为特殊类别个人数据的条款。

e9c1a9298516ece5.en: The school website published a list of children with surnames and health information. When I asked for it to be removed, they said, “You signed consent.” They suggest discussing it in the shared parents’ chat. I do not want the data spreading further.
e9c1a9298516ece5.zh: 学校网站公开了一份儿童名单，包含姓氏和健康信息。我要求删除，他们却说：“您签过同意书。”他们建议在家长群里讨论。我不希望数据继续传播。

2e6fc360b54edc99.en: The plan risks further dissemination or exceeds the reception office’s authority. First correct how the materials are handled and where the case is routed.
2e6fc360b54edc99.zh: 该计划有进一步传播数据的风险，或超出接待处权限。应先纠正材料处理方式及办理路径。

a8eb8ca17a8a08b3.en: The materials are ready for referral to the competent authority, with restricted access to sensitive attachments. The authorised authority assesses whether there is a violation and what measures to take.
a8eb8ca17a8a08b3.zh: 材料已准备按管辖权转交，敏感附件访问已受限。是否违法及采取哪些具体措施，由有权机关评估。

46ad2d89bfbedf0e.en: An ordinary public service through a multifunctional centre
46ad2d89bfbedf0e.zh: 多功能政务服务中心办理的普通政务服务

b254ca6b53b7adbe.en: A complaint under 59-FZ involving assessment of the special requirements of 152-FZ
b254ca6b53b7adbe.zh: 依据59-FZ提出、需评估152-FZ特别要求的投诉

2adc84f77204e7c0.en: The publication and the responsible school employee’s refusal to remove it.
2adc84f77204e7c0.zh: 投诉公开发布行为，以及学校负责人员拒绝删除。

a01b2013c7a8ed17.en: The complaint concerns the school’s own actions.
a01b2013c7a8ed17.zh: 投诉针对学校自身行为。

6bf65980b1f8ed48.en: Whose actions are you complaining about?

ee77342eb224d18a.en: The general consent signed on enrolment. They have not shown me separate consent to dissemination.
ee77342eb224d18a.zh: 他们引用入学时签署的一般同意书，没有向我出示单独的传播同意书。

302713f23d59c91c.en: A proper basis for dissemination has not been confirmed.
302713f23d59c91c.zh: 尚未确认存在适当的传播依据。

595e4d3cba475b18.en: Which consent does the school refer to?
595e4d3cba475b18.zh: 学校援引的是哪一份同意？

595c997160f4171b.en: Children’s surnames and notes about vaccinations and medical groups. I brought a mock copy with names concealed.
595c997160f4171b.zh: 儿童姓氏，以及接种和医疗分组记录。我带来了一份遮去姓名的教学副本。

ecd28f25490cd5cd.en: Health information, a special category of data, has been published.
ecd28f25490cd5cd.zh: 公开了属于特殊类别数据的健康信息。

dff4d8b38214464e.en: Anyone, even without signing in to the school website. The publication is still accessible.
dff4d8b38214464e.zh: 任何人都可以，即使不登录学校网站也能查看。内容仍可访问。

40f8afe04905eaeb.en: The publication is accessible to an indefinite audience.
40f8afe04905eaeb.zh: 该内容可由不特定公众访问。

487083efa390a603.en: To the parents’ chat for a collective vote
487083efa390a603.zh: 发到家长群进行集体投票

cee535487ab41fa8.en: Roskomnadzor; separately, the education authority if needed within its remit
cee535487ab41fa8.zh: 俄罗斯通信、信息技术和大众传媒监督局；必要时另交教育管理机关按其权限处理

864ec0b6e50e3c91.en: Roskomnadzor under its personal-data protection remit
864ec0b6e50e3c91.zh: 由俄罗斯通信、信息技术和大众传媒监督局依个人数据保护权限处理

cf24a07d6cf8ee62.en: Only to the school whose actions are challenged, to consider that same complaint
cf24a07d6cf8ee62.zh: 仅交由被投诉学校审理针对其自身的同一投诉

b99ae0c9cfec4b06.en: But this is my child’s data

1c692d8476e75da9.en: The consent’s contents, the data category and the controller’s actions matter. The assistant’s conclusion is too broad.
1c692d8476e75da9.zh: 同意的内容、数据类别和数据处理者的行为都很重要。助手的结论过于笼统。

d82aa50e68b8e3e3.en: No: check the basis, purposes and separate requirements for dissemination.
d82aa50e68b8e3e3.zh: 不对：应核查依据、目的和传播的单独要求。

8728fe5e819f344c.en: Yes: any consent permits any subsequent publication.
8728fe5e819f344c.zh: 对：任何同意都允许之后的任何公开发布。

f43e1ff20876f1de.en: Digital assistant: “If parents signed consent on enrolment, surnames and medical information can be published without a separate check.”
f43e1ff20876f1de.zh: 电子助手：“如果家长入学时签过同意书，就可以不经单独核查公开姓氏和医疗信息。”

92e472d3816d13d6.en: Prepare a check of the site, authority and implementation conditions
92e472d3816d13d6.zh: 准备核查场地、权限及实施条件

98ae2be3d7c06f54.en: Communicate the review outcome without promising unapproved funding
98ae2be3d7c06f54.zh: 告知审议结果，不承诺尚未获批的资金

9c2a50907c78f653.en: Guarantee installation by month-end using an unapproved budget
9c2a50907c78f653.zh: 承诺用尚未批准的预算在月底前完成安装

5726fa38242180bc.en: Record the proposal and attached plan
5726fa38242180bc.zh: 记录建议及所附示意图

5cba70f5772a6117.en: Refuse to consider the appeal because no rights have yet been violated
5cba70f5772a6117.zh: 因尚无权利受侵害而不审议诉求

d36fe37628dc2ca1.en: Pass the materials to an authorised employee for consideration
d36fe37628dc2ca1.zh: 将材料交给授权工作人员审议

9c1e4e0222cf4bca.en: The written appeal and plan have been accepted. There is no information about injuries or a current emergency. You prepare materials for consideration of the proposal within the recipient’s authority.
9c1e4e0222cf4bca.zh: 已受理附示意图的书面诉求。没有人员受伤或当前事故的信息。你应在收件机关权限内准备建议审议材料。

89247503a746d944.en: A recommendation to improve the social environment may be a proposal.
89247503a746d944.zh: 改善社会环境的意见可以属于建议。

a96add7dfb7e30f4.en: This is a retained standalone scenario supplied earlier, not a new variant in this release.
a96add7dfb7e30f4.zh: 这是保留的早期独立情境，不是本版本新增变体。

1e941c9188d15604.en: Promising a budget commitment outside one’s authority.
1e941c9188d15604.zh: 超越权限承诺预算义务。

a3566f01b465e254.en: The case materials show that funding for this initiative has not yet been approved. The trainee cannot enter into budget commitments.
a3566f01b465e254.zh: 案卷材料表明，该倡议的资金尚未获批。实习生无权作出预算承诺。

6bda0b09ab9e463d.en: I propose considering two benches and a canopy at points A and B. Please inform me of the outcome. I am not identifying a specific offender.
6bda0b09ab9e463d.zh: 建议考虑在A、B两处设置两张长椅和一个遮棚。请告知审议结果。我没有指出具体违规者。

6a1727ee6b15bdbc.en: The initiative may be considered as a proposal; absence of a violation is not a reason to ignore the appeal.
6a1727ee6b15bdbc.zh: 该倡议可作为建议审议；没有违法行为并不构成忽视诉求的理由。

19d0409dd9d290a4.zh: 已经签订的长椅安装合同。

0b9d3b3b6d31abcd.en: A recommendation to improve the area.

d8c67940e705c855.en: A demand to fine a specific person.

0e2658579a2ef334.zh: 这份诉求的事项是什么？

b1d17e89230527d4.en: A restriction affecting one part is not a review outcome for the whole initiative. The other location is still being checked.
b1d17e89230527d4.zh: 部分地点受限并不代表整个倡议的审议结果。另一处地点仍在核查。

3d8582247038f520.en: The unit reports that underground utilities occupy one proposed location. There is no information about the second location yet.
3d8582247038f520.zh: 部门报告称，一处拟选地点有地下管线。另一处地点尚无信息。

855a7f46642cc27e.en: Declare both locations impossible without checking the second.
855a7f46642cc27e.zh: 未核查第二处地点，就宣布两处都不可行。

4e65ee642ba2b3a9.en: Install a bench above the utilities despite the information received.
4e65ee642ba2b3a9.zh: 无视已获得的信息，在管线上方安装长椅。

c1b1c9063d0b823a.en: State the established restriction and clarify feasibility at the second location.
c1b1c9063d0b823a.zh: 反映已确认的限制，并核实第二处地点的可行性。

c9d944560c011799.en: Only complaints about harm already caused may be considered.
c9d944560c011799.zh: 只能审理针对已经造成损害的投诉。

c1e5c6a56f8e602c.en: A proposal automatically requires expenditure to be approved.
c1e5c6a56f8e602c.zh: 提出建议就自动要求批准支出。

730edfd77c8a5910.en: Find the provision defining a citizen’s proposal.
730edfd77c8a5910.zh: 查找公民建议定义的规定。

acf0e2c6126d5f4c.en: There is nowhere to sit on the way to the clinic. I drew locations for two benches and a small canopy. I am not asking for anyone to be punished. Could this idea be considered?
acf0e2c6126d5f4c.zh: 去诊所的路上没有地方坐。我画出了两张长椅和一个小遮棚的位置。我不要求处罚任何人，能否考虑这个想法？

4682ead940e3d077.zh: 公民诉求的一般办理程序

16556b6e444a2d38.en: A request for information on public-authority activities
16556b6e444a2d38.zh: 关于公共机关活动的信息请求

69ea83384711410a.en: A pre-trial complaint about service provision
69ea83384711410a.zh: 关于服务提供的诉前投诉

a1fcc4f70eff9f17.en: I want the possibility of benches to be considered. I understand the locations and funding still need discussion.
a1fcc4f70eff9f17.zh: 我希望考虑设置长椅的可能性。我理解地点和资金还需要讨论。

d6cc342a682adbab.en: A recommendation to improve the area, not a demand for punishment.
d6cc342a682adbab.zh: 这是改善区域环境的建议，并非要求处罚。

8ae85dc487c3be4e.en: On the attached plan, beside the route to the clinic, not on the roadway.
8ae85dc487c3be4e.zh: 在所附示意图上，位于去诊所的路线旁，不在车行道上。

359dd04f79e120f2.en: The locations are marked on the plan.
359dd04f79e120f2.zh: 地点已在示意图中标明。

29930bd8fb019a14.en: No. It is a proposal for future improvements.
29930bd8fb019a14.zh: 不是，这是关于今后环境改善的建议。

abfe04f8d510504d.en: Is this a request to remove an immediate danger?
abfe04f8d510504d.zh: 这是要求立即消除危险吗？

ef72a2c4ef9659b6.en: Return it to the citizen until they raise the budget themselves.
ef72a2c4ef9659b6.zh: 退回给公民，要求其先自行筹集资金。

5abaa762b1cfa337.en: Refer the proposal to the recipient authority’s competent area-improvement unit.
5abaa762b1cfa337.zh: 将建议交给收件机关负责环境改善的主管部门。

6053bce77dfd068a.en: Send it to the police because every appeal is a complaint.
6053bce77dfd068a.zh: 认为所有诉求都是投诉，因此转给警察。

ddbbfb7c6837d5f6.en: Find the provision and check its applicability. A source page does not replace justification of the decision.
ddbbfb7c6837d5f6.zh: 查找规定并核实适用性。来源页面不能代替对决定的论证。

e25fa78835733142.en: An appeal may contain a proposal; considering it does not mean it must be approved.
e25fa78835733142.zh: 诉求可以包含建议；审议建议不等于必须批准。

c255dcb1bc8c4d39.en: Agree and refuse to consider the initiative.
c255dcb1bc8c4d39.zh: 认同该说法，不再审议倡议。

a4422573bf8494d2.en: Guarantee funding immediately instead of conducting a review.
a4422573bf8494d2.zh: 不经审议，立即保证资金。

7324f5fa0eef7203.en: Check the type of appeal: proposals must also be considered.
7324f5fa0eef7203.zh: 核查诉求类型：建议同样应予审议。

2a130c58b3171d56.en: Assistant: “No violated right means no valid appeal.”
2a130c58b3171d56.zh: 助手：“没有权利受侵害，就不算诉求。”

6f4c7855fe6b754a.en: Clarify the form in which the applicant is acting
6f4c7855fe6b754a.zh: 明确申请人采用的参与形式

2e2e22edfa29b220.en: Accept the proposal under the proper procedure

a563ba14b721ffb0.en: Refer it to the competent unit for substantive assessment
a563ba14b721ffb0.zh: 交主管部门作实质性评估

f501fb4105cce55d.en: Explain the difference between considering and approving a project
f501fb4105cce55d.zh: 说明审议项目与批准项目的区别

4e6efcf37f790c18.en: Check that the response addresses the matter and contains no false spending promise
4e6efcf37f790c18.zh: 核查答复是否切题，以及是否存在虚假的支出承诺

b881188aa66bbe99.en: Refuse registration because majority support is absent
b881188aa66bbe99.zh: 因未获多数人支持而拒绝登记

7939ec9440ff1063.en: Announce budget approval on behalf of the reception office
7939ec9440ff1063.zh: 以接待处名义宣布预算获批

51520655a039e8ef.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. This is an ordinary individual proposal under Law No. 59-FZ. The citizen is not submitting a special initiative project, confirming a general-meeting decision or claiming authority from all residents. The established mandatory details suffice for consideration of the proposal; the competent decision-maker decides expenditure separately.
51520655a039e8ef.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。这是依据第59-FZ号法律提出的普通个人建议。公民未提交特殊的居民倡议项目，未确认居民大会决议，也未声称代表全体居民。具备已规定的必要要件即可审议建议；支出由有权主体另行决定。

6fd46cb04b8c664c.en: The request and documents determine the form of participation. An ordinary individual appeal must not be turned into mandatory signature collection.
6fd46cb04b8c664c.zh: 请求及文件决定参与形式。不能把普通个人诉求变成强制征集签名。

2dc6b1e1cd64d927.en: Article 2 of Law No. 59-FZ establishes the right to individual and collective appeals. An ordinary citizen’s proposal does not automatically require signatures from most residents. If the applicant seeks a decision through a special participation mechanism, that procedure’s requirements apply; a letter alone neither approves a budget nor authorises representation of others.
2dc6b1e1cd64d927.zh: 第59-FZ号法律第2条规定个人和集体提出诉求的权利。普通公民建议不自动要求多数居民签名。如果申请人希望通过特定参与机制取得决定，应适用该程序的条件；信函本身既不批准预算，也不赋予代表他人的权限。

2fe82bb769537fa5.en: A majority requirement has been applied to an ordinary individual proposal without grounds. The request and documents determine the form of participation. An ordinary individual appeal must not be turned into mandatory signature collection.
2fe82bb769537fa5.zh: 没有依据地将多数人支持的要求用于普通个人建议。请求及文件决定参与形式。不能把普通个人诉求变成强制征集签名。

f020f1fc457a3ea7.en: A majority requirement has been applied to an ordinary individual proposal without grounds.
f020f1fc457a3ea7.zh: 没有依据地将多数人支持的要求用于普通个人建议。

cf03eb94fba6cdc8.en: Only groups of residents may submit proposals.
cf03eb94fba6cdc8.zh: 只有居民团体才有权提出建议。

5d098d988d0d523c.en: Accepting the letter immediately approves installation and the budget.
5d098d988d0d523c.zh: 受理信函就立即批准安装和预算。

707a924684840caa.en: Clarify the actual status: recording an idea is not approval to implement it. The request and documents determine the form of participation. An ordinary individual appeal must not be turned into mandatory signature collection.
707a924684840caa.zh: 明确实际状态：记录想法不等于批准实施。请求及文件决定参与形式。不能把普通个人诉求变成强制征集签名。

6a22189188043b0f.en: The proposal was added to the list of received ideas. The response called it “project approved”, although no implementation decision exists.
6a22189188043b0f.zh: 建议被列入已收到的想法清单。答复却称“项目已批准”，尽管尚无实施决定。

e637379e3d24e842.en: Clarify the actual status: recording an idea is not approval to implement it.
e637379e3d24e842.zh: 明确实际状态：记录想法不等于批准实施。

3d704635468e6ad4.en: Keep the promise to maintain residents’ interest.
3d704635468e6ad4.zh: 为维持居民兴趣，保留该承诺。

5f08dce5e8fb2aea.en: Remove the proposal from the register without considering it.
5f08dce5e8fb2aea.zh: 未经审议就从登记中删除建议。

7082f92005ff54f7.en: Require majority signatures for every letter.
7082f92005ff54f7.zh: 要求每封信都附多数人签名。

5890f744b9f221a5.en: Promise funding solely because the letter was registered.
5890f744b9f221a5.zh: 仅因信函已登记就承诺资金。

3c14b6e7a8682855.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Accept and consider an individual proposal without imposing another form of participation.
3c14b6e7a8682855.zh: 查找下列行动的法律依据：受理并审议个人建议，不强加其他参与形式。

f2a849fa3f98809a.en: I want to suggest a bench near the bus stop. They said my letter would only be accepted with signatures from most residents. For now, I am writing on my own behalf.
f2a849fa3f98809a.zh: 我想建议在公交站旁放一张长椅。他们说只有附多数居民签名才受理信函。目前我只是以个人名义提出。

7a13874aaa5a3d4f.en: An individual bench proposal specifying the location and need. The signature and required details are present. There is no formal application under a special budget procedure.
7a13874aaa5a3d4f.zh: 个人提出设置长椅的建议，写明地点和需求，具备签名及必要要件。并未按特殊预算程序正式申报。

7503998bd424a3f2.en: An ordinary proposal differs from a formally submitted initiative project and a meeting resolution. It must be considered but does not itself allocate funding.
7503998bd424a3f2.zh: 普通建议不同于正式申报的居民倡议项目和会议决议。它应予审议，但本身不意味着拨款。

4a009e3e17aba8de.en: An employee demands majority signatures before accepting any proposal and refuses to register the letter.
4a009e3e17aba8de.zh: 工作人员要求任何建议都必须有多数居民签名才予受理，并拒绝登记信函。

9fcc7bdee00ae5a7.en: You prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. The materials establish the relevant authority. You do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions or send actual appeals. This is an ordinary individual proposal under Law No. 59-FZ. The citizen is not submitting a special initiative project, confirming a general-meeting decision or claiming authority from all residents. The established mandatory details suffice for consideration of the proposal; the competent decision-maker decides expenditure separately.
9fcc7bdee00ae5a7.zh: 你应在指定角色范围内准备决定和行动。材料已规定相关权限。你不处方治疗、不实施实际处罚，也不发送真实诉求。这是依据第59-FZ号法律提出的普通个人建议。公民未提交特殊的居民倡议项目，未确认居民大会决议，也未声称代表全体居民。具备已规定的必要要件即可审议建议；支出由有权主体另行决定。

97f896a2a130518d.en: Accept and consider an individual proposal without imposing another form of participation.
97f896a2a130518d.zh: 受理并审议个人建议，不强加其他参与形式。

d0c9a756d33f5dc9.en: Accept and consider an individual proposal without imposing another form of participation. The request and documents determine the form of participation. An ordinary individual appeal must not be turned into mandatory signature collection.
d0c9a756d33f5dc9.zh: 受理并审议个人建议，不强加其他参与形式。请求及文件决定参与形式。不能把普通个人诉求变成强制征集签名。

8a1e218d1f946151.en: An individual proposal may be considered without mandatory majority signatures.
8a1e218d1f946151.zh: 个人建议可以在不强制要求多数签名的情况下审议。

27233c7ffa52430d.en: Check the exact scope of representation
27233c7ffa52430d.zh: 核查代表权限的确切范围

8582d330a9926d1a.en: Separate the initiative’s subject from the additional data request
8582d330a9926d1a.zh: 区分倡议事项与另行提出的数据请求

86c2b129c73c26a4.en: Continue considering the available initiative materials
86c2b129c73c26a4.zh: 继续审议现有倡议材料

e3a33a08856e5c1e.en: Do not disclose other people’s protected information without grounds
e3a33a08856e5c1e.zh: 无依据时不得披露他人受保护信息

e8899bc1e8f3c489.en: Explain the proposal’s status and the access restriction separately
e8899bc1e8f3c489.zh: 分别说明建议状态及访问限制

15d83d32be6ffbe4.en: Disclose medical information without a legal basis
15d83d32be6ffbe4.zh: 无法律依据披露医疗信息

369369eddc5ddd7d.en: Require neighbours to supply diagnoses before an ordinary idea is accepted
369369eddc5ddd7d.zh: 受理普通想法前，要求邻居提供诊断

aaa62ef114602e2e.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. Authority to submit a collective proposal is confirmed. It does not include obtaining neighbours’ medical or other protected information. No legal basis for disclosure exists in the case. The proposal adequately describes the barrier and can be considered without that information. Do not demand each resident’s diagnosis for ordinary consideration of the idea.
aaa62ef114602e2e.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。提交集体建议的权限已确认，但不包括取得邻居的医疗或其他受保护信息。案中不存在披露的法律依据。建议本身已充分描述障碍，无需提供这些信息即可审议。普通想法的审议不应要求每位居民提供诊断。

e6b8ec6b7a850978.en: Authority is limited to a specific action. Supporting a useful initiative does not expand access to other people’s private lives.
e6b8ec6b7a850978.zh: 权限限于具体行动。支持有益倡议不会扩大访问他人私人信息的权利。

75a21e59cf74306c.en: Representation for a proposal does not establish the right to obtain others’ medical data. Authority is limited to a specific action. Supporting a useful initiative does not expand access to other people’s private lives.
75a21e59cf74306c.zh: 就建议事项担任代表，并不证明有权取得他人医疗数据。权限限于具体行动。支持有益倡议不会扩大访问他人私人信息的权利。

06a3f383b43df2aa.en: Representation for a proposal does not establish the right to obtain others’ medical data.
06a3f383b43df2aa.zh: 就建议事项担任代表，并不证明有权取得他人医疗数据。

37600ed5ea58c72f.en: Submitting a collective letter gives the representative access to all information about its participants.
37600ed5ea58c72f.zh: 提交集体信函就让代表有权获得参与者的所有信息。

8b34743e148fc4b2.en: The proposal cannot be considered without every neighbour’s diagnosis.
8b34743e148fc4b2.zh: 没有所有邻居的诊断，就不能审议建议。

1d12e28c0c649bcb.en: Do not treat that substitution as full anonymisation; prevent unlawful disclosure and continue considering the idea. Authority is limited to a specific action. Supporting a useful initiative does not expand access to other people’s private lives.
1d12e28c0c649bcb.zh: 不能将这种替换视为充分去标识化；应避免违法披露，并继续审议想法。权限限于具体行动。支持有益倡议不会扩大访问他人私人信息的权利。

98f7c7974e9de2df.en: A table has been prepared without names but with apartment numbers and diagnoses that identify particular neighbours.
98f7c7974e9de2df.zh: 准备的表格虽无姓名，却包含能识别具体邻居的房号和诊断。

2a7b6e9c420ae0e8.en: Do not treat that substitution as full anonymisation; prevent unlawful disclosure and continue considering the idea.
2a7b6e9c420ae0e8.zh: 不能将这种替换视为充分去标识化；应避免违法披露，并继续审议想法。

6cd36ce2d6d07cb3.en: Release the table because surnames have been removed.
6cd36ce2d6d07cb3.zh: 因已删除姓氏而提供表格。

52702d8f4509c18e.en: Reject the entire idea solely because of an excessive information request.
52702d8f4509c18e.zh: 仅因附加信息请求过度，就拒绝整个想法。

68b5fcbaf86457de.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Separate consideration of the initiative from impermissible disclosure of its protected part.
68b5fcbaf86457de.zh: 查找下列行动的法律依据：将倡议审议与不得披露的受保护部分区分处理。

41ec8cc1f45b16c7.en: We are asking for better access to our building. I represent the initiative group. Give us every neighbour’s medical information too; we will attach it to our proposal.
41ec8cc1f45b16c7.zh: 我们请求改善楼房通行条件。我代表倡议小组。请再提供所有邻居的医疗信息，我们会附在建议中。

c6e6bfe1425d35d0.en: The group authorised the citizen to submit a proposal to improve entrance accessibility and receive a response. There is no authority to obtain participants’ medical information.
c6e6bfe1425d35d0.zh: 小组授权该公民提交改善入口无障碍条件的建议并接收答复，但未授权其取得参与者的医疗信息。

419dc861441e185d.en: Alongside the proposal, the citizen requests all neighbours’ health information. That information is not public; no consent to disclosure or other basis has been provided.
419dc861441e185d.zh: 除建议外，该公民还请求所有邻居的健康信息。这些信息并不公开，也未提供披露同意或其他依据。

05e67ba05a5acafa.en: The entrance plan and description of the barrier allow the idea to be considered without a medical list. Specific implementation methods and funding are still being assessed.
05e67ba05a5acafa.zh: 入口示意图及障碍说明已足以支持审议，无需医疗名单。具体实施方式和资金仍在评估。

ba36b0db1439498f.en: You prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. The materials establish the relevant authority. You do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions or send actual appeals. Authority to submit a collective proposal is confirmed. It does not include obtaining neighbours’ medical or other protected information. No legal basis for disclosure exists in the case. The proposal adequately describes the barrier and can be considered without that information. Do not demand each resident’s diagnosis for ordinary consideration of the idea.
ba36b0db1439498f.zh: 你应在指定角色范围内准备决定和行动。材料已规定相关权限。你不处方治疗、不实施实际处罚，也不发送真实诉求。提交集体建议的权限已确认，但不包括取得邻居的医疗或其他受保护信息。案中不存在披露的法律依据。建议本身已充分描述障碍，无需提供这些信息即可审议。普通想法的审议不应要求每位居民提供诊断。

1b6d99b73550c468.en: Separate consideration of the initiative from impermissible disclosure of its protected part.
1b6d99b73550c468.zh: 将倡议审议与不得披露的受保护部分区分处理。

cf62f9d2ea53f1a4.en: Support the idea — do not disclose others’ information
cf62f9d2ea53f1a4.zh: 支持想法，不泄露他人信息

f5c0703a763668e3.en: Separate consideration of the initiative from impermissible disclosure of its protected part. Authority is limited to a specific action. Supporting a useful initiative does not expand access to other people’s private lives.
f5c0703a763668e3.zh: 将倡议审议与不得披露的受保护部分区分处理。权限限于具体行动。支持有益倡议不会扩大访问他人私人信息的权利。

cf7d915b35c2e837.en: Release the medical list under the initiative group’s general authority.
cf7d915b35c2e837.zh: 凭倡议小组的一般授权提供医疗名单。
